draggable.$description: Draggable: anything the user moves with the pointer, a finger or the arrow keys; a copy after the pointer when told.

box.$description: The draggable: `draggable` when the whole of it takes the press, `dragging` while it moves, `focus` when the keys have it.

handle.$description: The handle inside it that takes the press and the keys, when one is named: `hover`, `focus`.
